text: A double header for Senator Hardy and me as we par [image: A double header for Senator Hardy and me as we participated in TWO great panels on Tuesday night! The first at the Ilsley Library to discuss Early Education. Great questions about preschool access, Act 76, and how family, housing challenges are a huge factor in Vermont kids’ educational success. It was unfortunate that only Democratic candidates showed up for this incredibly important issue, but here we are in our dedication and glory! (@stroupforvt arrived just after the photo was taken) @robinscheu @bykerforvermont @mikeroyforvermont @ari_for_addison3 @jubilee4vt @hescockforvthouse @ruthhardyvt Then on to Addison to discuss hunting and fishing and land use with the Addison County Sportsman’s Club. It was a full house at the Addison Fire Station for a lively meeting. Hunting is a huge and critical part of Vermont culture and, like farmers, our outdoors people are often times the closest to, and have the most reverence for, our natural environment. We appreciate the invitations!]
